title: Automatic Microarchitecture-Aware Custom Instruction Design for RISC-V Processors
problem: Designing Application-Specific Instruction Set Processors (ASIPs) requires manually identifying custom instructions that improve performance without excessive area and power overhead—a labor-intensive process lacking automation.
motivation: Automating custom instruction discovery enables rapid ASIP design from general-purpose RISC-V baselines while maintaining programmability benefits.
method: CIDRE automatically analyzes hot spots in RISC-V applications using profiling and generates custom instruction suggestions with corresponding nML descriptions. The tool integrates with EDA tools to assess cost-benefit trade-offs for each suggested instruction.
key_novelty: Fully automated front-to-back ASIP design flow for RISC-V with automatic hot-spot detection and instruction generation.
contributions: Automated analysis of RISC-V application hot spots
Automatic custom instruction suggestion with nML descriptions
Up to 2.47× acceleration of embedded benchmarks with <24% area increase
Fully automated end-to-end ASIP design without manual intervention
limitations: Study focuses on embedded benchmarks; effectiveness for complex applications unclear.
primary_theme: Automated custom instruction design for RISC-V ASIPs
